deployments_detail.use: AI used for KYC (Know Your Customer) identity verification / onboarding. The IPO-period article reports 'L'intelligence artificielle y est déjà utilisée pour le KYC' (AI is already used for KYC). [none]
AI-powered chatbot referenced for merchant e-commerce integration (customer response + payment routing); described by third-party integration blog, not primary disclosure

AI applied to improve customer-relationship management / steering ('l'amélioration du pilotage de la relation client'). Listed in the 2025 annual report as one of the two priorities for the company's first AI use cases in 2025. [none]

Omnichannel client-interaction centralization project launched in 2025 to consolidate exchanges across social networks, WhatsApp, the mobile app, email and the call center, to more efficiently identify recurring issues (data foundation supporting the AI customer-relationship work). [none]
AI used for personalization of services to customers. Reported as already in use: 'L'intelligence artificielle y est déjà utilisée pour ... la personnalisation des services.' [none]

In-house AI fraud-scoring tool that evaluates the risk of fraudulent use of client accounts. The 2025 annual report states it was 'développé en interne' and is 'Opérationnel sur un périmètre restreint' (operational on a restricted perimeter), with wider deployment planned for 2026. Cash Plus also created a dedicated anti-fraud entity in 2025. [In-house (developed internally)]
